primaryHypothesis.designContribution: A bounded directional impact sentence should expose hit source, target and severity quickly enough to support causal learning.
primaryHypothesis.intendedPlayerBehavior: The player notices where damage came from, relates it to the struck component and can later explain the relevant failure.
primaryHypothesis.recognitionTest: On mobile during combat, players identify source direction, struck target and damaged versus critical severity without a color-only signal.
primaryHypothesis.decisionMetric: A non-briefed player points to the correct incoming direction and target after one event without the effect obscuring the next decision.
primaryHypothesis.failureCondition: The effect reads as a symmetric explosion, hides the target, points the wrong way, persists too long or communicates severity only through hue.
guardrails: No full-screen flash, persistent fog, camera obstruction or unbounded particle count.
Direction must derive from the real impact vector.
Reduced-motion and photosensitivity settings must retain causal information.
primaryHypothesis.claimBoundary: The VFX is an information design hypothesis and does not by itself prove understanding, retention or correct runtime damage.

productIntent.evidenceBoundary: These bindings express falsifiable design intent only; retention, readability, implementation and runtime behavior remain unproven until their named human and technical gates pass.

identity.gameplayFunction: communicate hit direction, damage severity and impact cause
identity.worldRole: A short-lived visual sentence that tells the player where the hit came from, what it struck and how severe the consequence is.

identity.emotionalIntent: Punchy, satisfying and informative without obscuring the target, camera or next decision.

instantRead.oneSecondPromise: A clear wedge, arc and few large fragments point back to the impact source and distinguish serious from critical damage.

instantRead.interactionCue: No interaction affordance is present; the effect only explains an event.
instantRead.dangerCue: Severity grows through angle, scale, fragmentation, timing and audio, never through hue alone.
instantRead.relationToPlayer: Neutral explanatory feedback that supports competence and post-failure understanding.

proportionRules: The effect remains inside a four-stud cube around the impact center.

views.front: A directional wedge and arc terminate at the impact center with few large fragments spreading along the force vector.
views.back: The source direction remains inferable through taper and fragment trail rather than a symmetric explosion.
views.left: The primary wedge shows depth and a clean origin-to-impact relationship.
views.right: The counter-profile confirms the same vector and avoids spherical fog.
views.top: A readable directional fan reveals hit angle without surrounding the target uniformly.
views.bottom: No decorative underside exists; any ground contact is a brief directional dust shape.
views.threeQuarterFront: The canonical view shows source vector, target contact, severity arc and limited fragments in one glance.
views.threeQuarterBack: The taper and residual trail preserve causality from the opposite side.
views.gameCamera: At mobile scale the effect reads as one arrow-like event sentence and disappears before it blocks the next decision.

artDirection.territoryThesis: A transient Salvaged Frontier impact sentence communicates target, direction, severity and cause through one graphic vector, material-matched fragments and restrained dusty weight without becoming physical scenery.

two or three large target-matched fragments

artDirection.exaggeration: Direction and severity are enlarged enough to read for a fraction of a second on mobile, while fragment count, spark density and total screen coverage remain strictly bounded.
artDirection.edgeLanguage: The main vector uses one clean graphic edge and the fragments inherit the target material; no structural bevel language, chassis outline or persistent solid frame is allowed.
artDirection.detailDensity: One primary vector, one secondary arc and at most three readable fragments carry the effect; micro-particles and decorative debris are forbidden.
artDirection.asymmetry: Asymmetry follows the impact direction and target normal only; the same vector topology must remain consistent across diagnostic views of one generated state.
artDirection.materialLanguage: Fragments briefly inherit the struck material, warm copper-gold edges indicate force and a restrained dust body adds frontier tactility; the effect owns no chassis material system.
artDirection.paletteLogic: Target-matched fragments and a bounded warm force accent carry meaning; mint interaction, permanent player-construction colors and broad critical red fields are forbidden.
artDirection.surfaceTreatment: Use crisp vector readability, broad translucent dust and a few solid fragments with no painted lighting, texture chatter, smoke cloud or cinematic bloom.
artDirection.wearLogic: The effect has no persistent wear history; severity changes the same impact sentence and disappears without leaving invented geometry or undocumented damage.
